title: manuscript-guard author-attested values
description: Values the author read in a source the toolkit could not retrieve and store. These are deliberately kept in a separate file from the ledger so that the set of numbers resting on a human's word, rather than on a stored artefact, can be reviewed at a glance by a co-author, a reviewer, or the author months later. Entries feed the same {{lit.<key>}} namespace as the ledger.

citekey.description: Optional: present when the work is in Zotero even though its text could not be stored.

source.description: What was read, in enough detail to be found again: full reference, database and query, personal communication, regulatory document number.

statement.description: The attester's own words: what they saw and why it could not be stored. This is the record that a human personally checked the value.

attested_by.description: Name of the person taking responsibility for the value.
